notes: The projection lemmas establish the inter-axis distance independently, avoiding the documented pitfall. However, Step 3 uses (max{r−l,0})² ≥ (r−l)², which is false for r=0, l=1 (take x on A). This invalidates the written infinite-inertia argument. Remark 3 also falsely claims equality only when l=0: when I₀=∞, I=I₀ for every finite l.
